rows.grounds: compound of ugrā (fierce), āpatti (calamity), and tāriṇī (rescuer); feminine nominative singular
proper name of the goddess; feminine nominative singular
past passive participle describing the goddess; from root kīrt with pra

items.question: What etymological reason justifies the goddess being named Ugratārā?
premises: The goddess is characterized as rescuing from fierce calamities.
This rescuing function provides the basis for her designation.
The name Ugratārā is applied to her in recognition of this quality.
items.inference: Because she rescues from fierce calamities, she is proclaimed as Ugratārā.
items.plain_english: Because she rescues from fierce calamities, she is proclaimed as Ugratārā.
